currentSource.boundary: Review 2026-10-26 fix round R3 (REVIEW-R2 B-4, DESIGN-CRITIQUE-R2 R2-B1/B4 and N2/N3/N9/N11/N12/N13 on codex/redesign-20261026): the record Source value and the Region value wrap only between their " · " tokens (nowrap token spans), below 900px Page takes its own width and Region the rest, the KO page value is the KO Home sans, below 768px the s2 region crop is hidden as the s3 record crop is (it is width-bound at about 5 eq px on a 412 phone), Home meta/detail text reads a --home-meta-fs size (13px, 14px on /ko), and the film play/pause plate is a 36px ::before disc inside the 44px control. The three reader-guide heading rules, .readerGuide's ink and paper, and the legacy --home-ink #14171a / --home-paper #f6f3ec are unchanged. Before that: Review 2026-10-26 fix round (REVIEW B-2/B-4, DESIGN-CRITIQUE B1-B5 on codex/redesign-20261026): text links carry no underline at rest (hover and focus-visible only), the passage pane holds no bordered chip or box inside it (the crop alone keeps a line), the phone region letters are outlined rather than filled and the row wash is off below 768px, the record's Source and Version fields take the full width below 900px with the filename breaking only at its spaces, the record's region window is hidden below 768px, and the film's play/pause mark is a round translucent instrument-ground plate. The three reader-guide heading rules, .readerGuide's ink and paper, and the legacy --home-ink #14171a / --home-paper #f6f3ec are unchanged. Before that: FINAL-SPEC 2026-10-26 C7 (Home redesign, e2e and measurement round): the phone region list draws letter badges (lever 2), and /ko's film disclosure takes no tracking (§4.4 KO rule). Before that: Re-measured 2026-10-26 on codex/redesign-20261026 for FINAL-SPEC 2026-10-26 C4 (css): the workbench, record sheet and section rhythm follow the spec (s2 title is the section h2 and stays visible on a phone, the passage card and region list are restyled, the record sheet is one 966px sheet with its own region window), and the blocks Home no longer renders are deleted (the context disclosure, difficulty list, receive notes, method steps, reserved line and the dead .home scene rules); s4-s6 are the instrument ground through .lv2-obsidian, and the s4-s6 paper repaint and the eyebrow, intake and formats rules are deleted from the mounted root. The three reader-guide heading rules, .readerGuide's ink and paper, and --ink #15191d / --paper #faf9f6 and the legacy --home-ink #14171a / --home-paper #f6f3ec are unchanged. Before that: Re-measured 2026-10-19 on codex/ux-program-20261017 for lane P2-09 (UX-L10, UX-PLAN-2026-10-17 §4.2-1, §4.6 and §4.9): the passage card's coordinate chip (.lineLabel) is ink (var(--home-ink)) instead of the accent var(--home-cobalt), so the accent stays on the Evidence Line and its region outline, and under prefers-reduced-motion the workbench (article.bench and its descendants and pseudo-elements) declares transition: none !important in @layer components, where it outranks the site-wide .lv2 * opacity fade; no heading rule or token changed and --home-ink #14171a and --home-paper #f6f3ec are unchanged. Before that: Re-measured 2026-10-17 on codex/ux-program-20261017 for lane P2-03 (UX-L1, UX-PLAN-2026-10-17 §8.2): the legacy .home tokens --home-cobalt and --home-cobalt-deep read var(--tv-action) and var(--tv-action-hover) instead of the retired #2347b8 and #1b3891, --home-amber, --home-amber-wash and --home-amber-ink read the ink-neutral --tv-* region tokens, and the selected region's wash is var(--tv-rule) instead of rgb(242 183 58 / 0.3); --home-ink #14171a and --home-paper #f6f3ec are unchanged, and inputCommit stays the reviewed base these edits apply to. Before that: Canonical Git LF bytes of main bcba7173 (Home Release 3, PR #150), re-measured 2026-10-16 at its merge into codex/masterplan-checkpoint-2026-09-30 (merge 92d219f1, same blob). Release 3's 86f2794d deleted this legacy module's `@layer overrides` .home token block (--home-ink #15191d / --home-paper #fbfaf7 !important), so .home keeps only its original unlayered normal tokens, which equal the historical ink and paper. Previously main dbe22b1e's source at merge c9d7bc67 (blob 3588bbaf, 39138 bytes, important override in overrides). No new product CSS, browser pixels, release qualification or renaming of historical evidence.
